summary: Restarted the unresponsive dedicated Community Chrome; collected and published 39 items and 80 links; added automatic CDP-timeout self-healing for future scheduled retries.
checks: Community gate passed with 39 items and 80 links
issues: Chrome HTTP CDP health check passed while the CDP WebSocket session stopped responding.
risks: Restart is restricted to Chrome processes using the dedicated community profile and configured debugging port.
lessons: HTTP CDP availability alone does not prove Playwright session responsiveness.
reusable_rules: On connectOverCDP timeout restart only the dedicated community browser and retry immediately.
